resources.string: Selection actions
Show a bar of actions for the text you select

Select text and the keyboard offers what you can do with it. Select all always comes first, so one tap takes the whole field. Select a phone number and you get Call and Message. Select a link and you get Open and QR. Anything else gets Copy, Share and the case options.\n\nThe bar only appears while something is selected. It goes away when you clear the selection.
Where it appears
The row the actions are drawn on
Own row
Suggestion strip
A row of its own above the keys, which arrives with the selection. The keyboard is one row taller while it is there. You can move the row up or down under Rows.
Over the suggestion strip, which costs no height. There are no word suggestions to show while text is selected.
Show on every selection
Keep Select all, Copy, Cut, Paste and Delete on very long selections

The keyboard does not read a selection longer than 4000 characters: reading one that size costs real time, and every action that works on the text needs it read first.

So a selection that long normally takes the whole bar away, Copy and Paste included, even though those two never needed the text — the app does that work itself.

On, the bar stays up past that length with Select all, Copy, Cut, Paste and Delete, whichever of them you have switched on. Everything else still waits for a shorter selection: the case options, the rewrites, and the actions for a phone number, an address or a link.

It also covers the few apps whose text boxes will not hand a selection over at all, where the same five actions are the only ones that can work.

Password fields never show the bar, whichever way this is set.
Show with nothing selected
Keep the row up at the caret, with Select all and Paste

Normally the row only appears while text is selected. On, it stays above the keys all the time, so the actions are there before you select anything.

With nothing selected it holds Select all and Paste, whichever of them you have switched on. Tap Select all and the full row for the whole text takes its place: Copy, Translate and the rest.

Only for the row of its own. Over the suggestion strip it would take the suggestions away while you type, so this switch is hidden there.

Password fields never show the row, whichever way this is set.
Actions
Read what is selected
Offer Call for a phone number, Open for a link, Email for an address

The keyboard reads the selection as a whole. A sentence with a phone number in it is text, not a number: you selected the sentence.

Switch this off and every selection is read as plain text. You keep Select all, Copy, Share and the case options, and lose the actions that are about a phone number, an address or a link.

Phone numbers use the same formats as the clipboard, under Privacy > Clipboard.

AI actions with a chip of their own on the bar

Each picked action gets a chip beside the AI chip that runs it on the selection at once. The result lands in the AI tool, ready to apply. The chips only appear while the AI tool is switched on and set up.

A picked action takes less room on the bar: it shows its icon and no name, and screen readers still say the name. Actions with no icon of their own, like the case options, always show their name.
